system.compatibility: Melee Weapon / Ranged Weapon / Magical Implement
system.effect:
Requirement: The host must be usable as Source for a damaging Action.

Once per turn, after an ordinary Source Action deals Damage to a creature, leave a visible echo in one space that creature occupies. Before the start of your next Turn, the first different creature entering that space takes 1 Damage of the type just dealt, then the echo ends. An unused echo ends at the start of your next Turn.

Affects allies as well as enemies. Echo Damage is not an attack, repeats no Rider, and triggers no Source on-hit property or further echo.
system.flavor: A hit leaves a small, temporary positioning hazard.
